A simple dish made by cooking skewered fresh fish alongside fragrant mushrooms.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Fish and Mushroom Skewers are made by [[Cooking]] any [[Mushroom]] with any [[Fish]]. Eating one will restore some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. The [[Fish]] used in these skewers are fresh, while the Mushrooms are fragrant. Several different variations of Fish and Mushroom Skewers exist, depending on both the [[Ingredient]]s are used and whether any additional Ingredients are added: * '''Hearty Fish and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Fish and Mushroom Skewer}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
A simple dish made by cooking skewered, fresh fish alongside fragrant mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Hearty Salmon]]s, [[Hearty Bass]], [[Hearty Truffle]]s, [[Big Hearty Truffle]]s, or [[Hearty Durian]]. When eaten, will heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. * '''Enduring Fish and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Fish and Mushroom Skewer}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
A simple dish made by cooking skewered, fresh fish alongside fragrant mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Endura Shroom]]s. Eating them will refill and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Fish and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Fish and Mushroom Skewer}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
A simple dish made by cooking skewered, fresh fish alongside fragrant mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Staminoka Bass]]es, [[Stamella Shroom]]s, or [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]s. If eaten, Link's Stamina Wheel will be partially refilled. * '''Hasty Fish and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Fish and Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
A simple dish made by cooking skewered, fresh fish alongside fragrant mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Rushroom]]s or [[Fleet-Lotus Seeds]]. Eating one will grant Link a temporary boost to his movement speed. * '''Spicy Fish and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Fish and Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
A simple dish made by cooking skewered, fresh fish alongside fragrant mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Sizzlefin Trout]]s or [[Sunshroom]]s. Link will gain one level of [[Cold Resistance]] when these are eaten. * '''Electro Fish and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Fish and Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants mid-level electricity resistance.
A simple dish made by cooking skewered, fresh fish alongside fragrant mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Voltfin Trout]], [[Zapshroom]]s, or [[Voltfruit]]s. Eating these Skewers will give Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Fish and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Fish and Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants a mid-level attack-power boost.
A simple dish made by cooking skewered, fresh fish alongside fragrant mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Mighty Carp]], [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]], [[Razorshroom]]s, or [[Mighty Bananas]]. Eating them will boost Link's attacks for a short time. * '''Tough Fish and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Fish and Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants a mid-level defense boost.
A simple dish made by cooking skewered, fresh fish alongside fragrant mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Armored Carp]], [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]], or [[Ironshroom]]s. If eaten, Link's [[Defense]] will increase. * '''Sneaky Fish and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Fish and Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
A simple dish made by cooking skewered, fresh fish alongside fragrant mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Stealthfin Trout]]s or [[Silent Shroom]]s. Eating one will temporarily increase Link's [[Stealth]]. * '''Chilly Fish and Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Fish and Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
A simple dish made by cooking skewered, fresh fish alongside fragrant mushrooms.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Chillfin Trout]]s, [[Chillshroom]]s, or [[Hydromelon]]s. When eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Heat Resistance]] temporarily. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Fish Skewer * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood, Skewers |items= BotW, TotK }}
